result.title: SlicePlanner: Logic-Guided Agentic AI for Online QoS-Aware Network Slicing in Open RAN
result.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Mobile Ad-Hoc and Smart Systems (MASS), October 21-23, 2026, Hong Kong SAR, China
result.summary: Adaptive network slicing in Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) demands reconfiguration decisions that respond to live traffic conditions while remaining safe with respect to Service Level Agreement (SLA) constraints, a combination that purely data-driven controllers cannot reliably guarantee without continuous retraining. We present SlicePlanner, a logic-guided closed-loop framework that treats each RAN reconfiguration as a controlled hypothesis: proposed from live and historical KeyPerformance Indicator (KPI) evidence, filtered through explicit SLA constraints and mined RAN control rules, and committed only when post-action measurements confirm improvement. SlicePlanner comprises two cooperating agents: SliceSense, which monitors live KPIs, retrieves context-conditioned evidence, and ranks candidate RAN actions through a surrogate-guided admissibility filter; and SliceGuard, which validates post-action KPI responses, rolls back harmful configurations, and refreshes rules under distribution drift. Validated over the air using OpenAirInterface, FlexRIC, and commercial Sierra Wireless 5G devices, SlicePlanner reduces SLA latency violations by up to 86% over static slicing and 50% over Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-based slicing, while maintaining comparable cell throughput and auditable decisions without online retraining.

AI.brief_summary: SlicePlanner 是一个逻辑引导的闭环 O-RAN 网络切片框架：由 SliceSense 基于实时与历史 KPI 证据检索并筛选候选重配置动作，SliceGuard 在执行后验证 KPI 响应、回滚有害配置并在分布漂移下更新规则，最终在真实 5G 试验平台上验证 SLA 违规显著下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「提出候选—约束与规则过滤—动作后证据验证—回滚或更新」的闭环，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、验证驱动的停止决策及失败回退设计有概念对应，但领域跨度大，仅为可供核查的类比线索。
